notes: The waw takes 'Yea', which stands in rule 14's open list of connectives read off the ASV.

s003 בְּ takes the written 'of' of 'sing of the ways' as its own relation; a preposition morpheme being present, rule 44's supplied-preposition clause does not reach the word (that rule's own first limit), and the chain's 'of' stands separately before 'Jehovah' under rule 19.
The copula of the second colon goes to the adjectival predicate גָדוֹל under rule 20 and not to the subject nominal כְּבוֹד, the unit discontinuous under rule 25 where the ASV fronts the predicate.
Both construct nouns take supplied 'the's, no article morpheme standing in either chain.
